create_UniqueNames_instance: create a UniqueNames instance with a custom prefix to generate unique names for objects
call_name_method: call the name method on a UniqueNames instance to get a unique string for any object
call_make_namer_default: call make_namer with no arguments to get a default namer function using UniqueNames
call_make_namer_with_prefix: call make_namer with a prefix string to get a namer that prepends the prefix to generated names
call_make_namer_custom: call make_namer with a custom callable to use that callable as the namer function
